title: Pullback of the zero chart class
statement: For schemes B,T,T′, maps a:T→B, b:T′→T and a′:T′→B with a′=b≫a, an étale pullback test square U→V over a′, any bounded-below derived abelian étale sheaf K on T and integer q, the specified cartesianChartClassPullback [def-sc-cartesian-chart-class-pullback-core] sends the zero class single(a*free(V))→K[q] to zero. No nonemptiness or degree restriction is required.

proof.text: Unfold the chart pullback and its explicit core. The exact derived inverse-image functor preserves zero morphisms because it is additive. Functor.map_zero makes its image of the zero class zero, and zero_comp and comp_zero annihilate every surrounding composite. This also proves the assertion in degree zero, negative shifts and empty schemes.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03CB and 0EYM; direct Functor.map_zero, zero_comp and comp_zero on the explicit chart-pullback formula.

lean.statement:
theorem cartesianChartClassPullback_zero {B T T' : Scheme.{u}}
    (a : T ⟶ B) (b : T' ⟶ T) (a' : T' ⟶ B) (ha : a' = b ≫ a)
    (V : B.Etale) (U : T'.Etale) (r : U.left ⟶ V.left)
    (hr : IsPullback r U.hom V.hom a')
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
    (q : ℤ)
    : cartesianChartClassPullback a b a' ha V U r hr K q 0 = 0
